description: Defines the RemoteTunnelManager actor responsible for managing SSH tunnels for remote gateways, including starting, stopping, and reusing tunnels, with support for asynchronous operations and logging.

classes.name: RemoteTunnelManager
classes.description: An actor that manages SSH tunnel lifecycle for remote gateway control, ensuring robust connection handling with restart logic.

methods.name: controlTunnelPortIfRunning
methods.description: Checks if an existing SSH tunnel is active and listening; if not, initiates a restart or reuses existing tunnels.

methods.name: ensureControlTunnel
methods.description: Ensures an SSH tunnel is established for the remote gateway control port, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: stopAll
methods.description: Terminates any active tunnels managed by this actor.

methods.name: isSshProcess
methods.description: Determines whether a process descriptor corresponds to an SSH process.

methods.name: beginRestart
methods.description: Initiates a controlled restart of the SSH tunnel with backoff logic.

methods.name: endRestart
methods.description: Marks the completion of a restart, resetting related flags and logging.

methods.name: waitForRestartBackoffIfNeeded
methods.description: Implements delay logic to prevent rapid restart cycles.
